rules.statement: A plaintiff can claim prescriptive title to land if they have been in uninterrupted possession of the land for ten years, without paying rent or performing any service or duty, and without acknowledging the rights of another person.
rules.supporting_quote: This position in law is supported by many authorities. Maasdorp's Institutes (7th Edition Vol2 at 96) Wigneswaran J in Leisa and another V Simon and Another [2002 (1) SLR 148] Pathirana V Jayasundera [58 NLR 169] Dona Cecilia V Cecilia Perera and others [1987 (1) SLR 235] Wijesundara and others v Constantine Dasa and another [1987 (2) SLR 66] I will now turn to consider whether the learned District Judge correctly evaluated the evidence and applied the law relevant thereto when he accepted the prescriptive rights .I 3 of the plaintiff rejecting the defence taken up by the defendant.
